Name: Capstone Professions
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Capstone Professions[/b] adds a final choice of professions once you max out all your skills.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Once you've maxed out all your skill levels, a new profession choice arrives overnight... Both professions stack with multiple players.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/174]All Professions[/url].

[/list]
